features.name: Mobile Layout
features.description: Phones get a layout built for touch; the desktop view is unchanged
details: Epoch row and tool tabs stay pinned at the top; tap the epoch number to copy it
🌍 button shows/hides the timezones in one compact line
Buttons share rows and tools open right where you tapped, so far less scrolling

features.name: Install as App
features.description: Add Multi Converter to your home screen and it opens full-screen like an app
details: Works offline after your first visit (Geo Sight lookups still need internet)
Android: Chrome menu → Install app · iPhone: Safari Share → Add to Home Screen

features.name: Code Formatter: JSON Lines / Logs
features.description: Paste one-JSON-per-line logs (e.g. Serilog, Docker) and get a clean, readable JSON array
details: Auto-detected, or pick JSON Lines / Logs from the list
Escaped JSON inside fields (like Serilog's @mt) is unpacked into real objects

features.name: New Icon & Fixes
features.description: Fresh app icon and link-preview artwork, plus a fix for PassCraft spacing on phones

features.name: Binary Lab
features.description: New number-base & bitwise toolkit, replacing the old Binary converter button in the Conversion Suite toolbar
details: 6 categories: Number Bases, Text ⇄ Binary, ASCII ⇄ Hex, Bit Operations, Advanced, Networking
11 tools: Multi-Base Converter, Custom Base, Text/Binary encode-decode, ASCII/Hex encode-decode, Bitwise Calculator, Two's Complement, IEEE-754 Float, Parity/Checksum, IPv4/CIDR
ASCII ⇄ Hex: ASCII, UTF-8 and UTF-16 (BE/LE) encodings, selectable delimiter, 0x or \x byte prefix, upper/lower case, one-click copy and a per-character breakdown table

features.name: Finance Lab
features.description: New bank & investment calculator suite, replacing the old Case converter button in the Conversion Suite toolbar
details: 12 calculators across Interest & Deposits, Loan/EMI, SIP & Investments, and Govt Schemes
Each shows summary stats plus a year-by-year breakdown table
